summary: The gyomu-facts package provides core analysis and directory ranking capabilities for evaluating software packages. It compiles package facts and computes directory importance scores to support automated architectural assessment.
responsibilities: Compile and structure architectural facts about software packages.
Evaluate and rank directories based on importance and scoring criteria.

capabilities.name: Package Analysis
capabilities.description: Analyze package structures and compile comprehensive package metadata and facts.

capabilities.name: Directory Ranking
capabilities.description: Calculate scores and rank directories using configurable selection criteria.

design_decisions: Leverages functional programming patterns and monadic error handling via the returns library.
Relies on shared infrastructure and schema definitions from sibling gyomu packages.
usage_guidance: Use package analysis modules to inspect and compile structural facts about target codebases.
Apply directory selection options and scoring functions to prioritize relevant source directories.
